info.description: REST API of the Dulo family tree server.
info.title: Dulo API

tags.description: Places where things happened, nested in larger places. Needs the places feature: view to read, create, edit and delete to change.
tags.name: Places

tags.description: Administration of the roles and their permissions. Needs the administration feature with the matching access. Only the root user may change the built-in roles, and nobody may delete them.
tags.name: Roles

tags.description: The people of the tree and their names. Needs the people feature: view to read, create, edit and delete to change.
tags.name: People

tags.description: Births, marriages, burials and everything else that happened. Needs the events feature: view to read, create, edit and delete to change.
tags.name: Events

tags.description: Partners and their children. Needs the families feature: view to read, create, edit and delete to change.
tags.name: Families

tags.description: The audit history: every change to every record, with the values before and after. Needs view access to the audit-log feature; changes to the tree settings, roles and users also need view access to administration.
tags.name: Audit

tags.description: Administration of the users: approve, disable, assign roles. Needs the administration feature: view to read, edit to change.
tags.name: Users

tags.description: The one-time initial setup. Until it's done, the rest of the API answers 503. The setup token is in the server log, or in dulo.setup.token.
tags.name: Setup

tags.description: The family tree of this server
tags.name: Tree

get.description: Returns the tree's name, description and the state of each feature. Every active user may read it.

401.description: No valid access token. The problem type is `urn:dulo:problem:unauthorized`.

403.description: The account is not active. The problem type is `urn:dulo:problem:account-pending` or `urn:dulo:problem:account-disabled`.

404.description: The initial setup is not done yet. The problem type is `urn:dulo:problem:tree-not-initialized`.

503.description: The initial setup isn't done yet. The problem type is `urn:dulo:problem:setup-required`.

patch.description: Changes the name, the description or the enabled features. Needs edit access to the administration feature. Left-out values stay as they are.

parameters.description: The ETag of the resource as last read. A change to an outdated copy fails with 412.
parameters.name: If-Match

400.description: Invalid change, e.g. an unknown feature or an empty name. The problem type is `urn:dulo:problem:validation`.

403.description: The caller may not change the tree. The problem type is `urn:dulo:problem:forbidden`, or says why the account is not active.

412.description: The tree changed since it was read. The problem type is `urn:dulo:problem:concurrent-modification`.

428.description: If-Match is missing. The problem type is `urn:dulo:problem:precondition-required`.
